source_corpora.reuse: candidate and H3a raw source evidence only; no epoch-0 B2-E/B2-F header, root, key, commitment, proof ID, distinct-set profile, or reason-8 fallback is spliced into checkpoint 28

raw H1/H2 fresh verification and cutoff-only pre-header next-epoch commitment authority
opaque locally authorized state-preserving empty native execution from authenticated height-27 state to height 28 state
deterministic checkpoint pre-header preparation with native empty payload, empty ordered receipts, state, empty evidence, and commitment roots
exact native BlockHeader and empty ApplicationPayloadV0 and ExecutionReceiptsV0 binding to canonical native BlockId
raw exact checkpoint/two-seal B2-E verification under StrictEd25519Verifier
raw exact terminal-old QC and old/new double-quorum B2-F verification under StrictEd25519Verifier
crate-private joint-handoff authorization seal; no aggregate protocol digest and no activation output

vector_contract.comet_rule: the single compact-profile comet_hash_mapping null marker is an explicit nonclaim; every Comet hash value, request hash, part-set header, or Comet BlockID field is forbidden

scheduled-cutoff and cutoff-only candidate private authorization IDs
raw exact cutoff-parent BlockHeader and H1 FinalityProofV0 CEV0 plus proof ID
complete raw H2 manifest, ICS23 membership list, and empty absence list
preheader: exact height-27 checkpoint-parent BlockHeader CEV0 and native BlockId
exact old/new ValidatorSetV0 and ConsensusParametersV0 CEV0
exact same-version NextEpochCommitmentV0 CEV0 and ID
checkpoint: exact empty ApplicationPayloadV0 and ExecutionReceiptsV0 CEV0 with zero transaction and receipt counts
preparation ID, exact native checkpoint BlockHeader CEV0, native BlockId, and private header authorization ID
height, view, timestamp, native payload/state/receipts/evidence roots, and commitment hash
checkpoint_finality: exact raw checkpoint/two-seal FinalityProofV0 CEV0 and proof ID
checkpoint 28, seal 29, and seal 30 native BlockIds and exact seal header CEV0
exact terminal old-set ordinary QC CEV0 and ID
handoff: exact HandoffDescriptorV0 and HandoffCertificateV0 CEV0 and IDs

checkpoint finality proof and handoff certificate IDs

numeric_contract.u16_u32_u64: canonical unquoted unsigned JSON integers over the exact Rust range; Node preserves unsafe u64 values as BigInt and rejects quoted integers, signs, floats, exponents, leading zeros, and overflow
numeric_contract.byte_strings: lowercase even-length hexadecimal; fixed IDs and roots are exactly 32 bytes
numeric_contract.runtime_receipt_limit: this vector has zero transactions and receipts and therefore makes no shared-vector claim about u128 fee, gas, runtime event, or UTF-8 attribute mapping

source_api_contract.raw_consumer_verifier: StrictEd25519Verifier is hard-coded inside the crate-private raw consumer
source_api_contract.raw_decoding: checkpoint parent, checkpoint/two-seal proof, and terminal-old/handoff kernel are freshly exact-decoded
source_api_contract.accepted_checkpoint_authority: only DurablyBoundPocoCheckpointHeaderV0; the raw non-durable binder is module-private/test-only and cannot enter the production-visible joint-handoff constructor
source_api_contract.execution_authority: only AuthorizedNativeCheckpointExecutionV0 bound to authenticated parent and post-state roots
source_api_contract.visibility: prepared, durable-bound checkpoint, and joint handoff capabilities remain crate-private; the joint constructor consumes the durable-bound capability by value
source_api_contract.joint_authorization_role: application-private authority seal only; it is not an aggregate EpochHandoffProof digest or wire object
source_api_contract.checkpoint_preparation_sidecar: landed as an application-private SQLite database independent of the application store, JMT, ABCI snapshots, and state-sync replacement; it uses WAL, synchronous=FULL, and BEGIN IMMEDIATE
source_api_contract.checkpoint_preparation_slots: one immutable transition binding plus slots keyed by (transition, checkpoint kind, height, view); exact reserve and bind replay is idempotent, while binding or occupied-slot conflict sets a process-sticky halt and records a durable halt when storage is available
source_api_contract.durable_checkpoint_wrappers: reserve_prepared_poco_checkpoint_header_v0(&PocoPreparationJournalV0, PreparedPocoCheckpointHeaderV0) -> Result<DurablyPreparedPocoCheckpointHeaderV0> and bind_durably_prepared_poco_checkpoint_header_v0(&PocoPreparationJournalV0, DurablyPreparedPocoCheckpointHeaderV0, &BlockHeader, &BlockBodyV0, &ExecutionReceiptsV0) -> Result<DurablyBoundPocoCheckpointHeaderV0> are the only durable wrapper path; journal.bind(&reservation, &bound_record)? must succeed before the sole production DurablyBoundPocoCheckpointHeaderV0 construction
source_api_contract.checkpoint_replay_role: stored canonical replay records and checksums are inert comparison material only and cannot be converted into or restore an opaque checkpoint, proposal, vote, handoff, activation, or signing authority
source_api_contract.checkpoint_sidecar_test_evidence: a focused Rust suite covers same-process reopen reserve/bind idempotence, same-slot conflict, higher-view retry, transition-binding splice, bound-header conflict, checksum-consistent semantic corruption, corrupt/future schema, failed halt persistence, schema drift, and path/file identity; this is not subprocess restart or external rollback-watermark evidence
source_api_contract.runtime_outcome_policy: active v0 receipts are success-only; an opaque exhaustive runtime taxonomy has 28 typed failures: 21 whole-block/no-receipt transaction rejects and 7 fail-stop invariant faults, while the crate-private outcome kernel keeps dependency failures Unavailable and remains unwired
